scope: Real map; synthetic keyboard/gamepad with menu-selection and progress fixtures; three-process isolated save checks. Physical controllers unverified.
passed: Fresh saves default to High fur detail
High detail selects the new raised-hair mesh
Fur acceptance uses an isolated save slot
Keyboard starts the real game before adjusting detail
Keyboard opens Pause for fur controls
Graphics controls display the current High fur level
Keyboard Left lowers High to Medium
Medium changes the actual mesh live and refreshes gait
D-pad Right restores High and the raised hairs
Keyboard Right wraps High to the smooth Low model
A-Cross cycles Low to Medium without leaving the menu
Enter cycles Medium to High live
Changing detail keeps Marty still and preserves patrol and sound state
The selected Medium quality is written to the save
